notes.title: New Content - Santa's Valley
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]

Santa’s Valley Mode:

A brand-new singleplayer mode just in time for the holidays! 🎅
- Explore Santa’s Valley, where your goal is to redecorate the valley and bring it back to life.
- Introduction to Game Modes: Learn about all core game modes while playing through this festive journey.
- Unlock Multiplayer Mode by completing Santa’s Valley challenges.


[b]Improvements[/b]

Tutorial Overhaul:
Based on community feedback, I've revamped the tutorial to make it more engaging, user-friendly, and informative.
